<thought>We will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that match the forward reaction description. We provide the target flavanone SMILES and specify the functional groups broken (aromatic hydroxyls, ketones) and formed (ether oxygens). We omit bond criteria to avoid format issues.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
